source: two field reports from a project that ran the previous implementation daily for about 14 months on about 215 names (a DCF on a bank, a DCF on a regulated utility mid capex cycle, an AISC screen on a royalty company, an insurer pinned at +571.9% upside), plus that implementation's own findings
notes: Models today: dcf (OperatingCompany), residual_income (Bank), residual_income_insurer (Insurer, needs filed statements). A class with [] has no admissible model yet and is refused with its lens named.
Inadmissible is Failed with the lens named: the reader learns what the right measurement is.
Anything that fits no class gets a class added to the boundary variant and a row here, never a place in OperatingCompany.

OperatingCompany.lens: FCFF-based DCF: positive, stable free cash flow with no structural break
OperatingCompany.never: a DCF through a structural break, an acquisition inside the growth window or a live impairment
OperatingCompany.floor_basis_default: a completed FCFF DCF: the discounted free cash flow per share

Bank.lens: price/book against ROE, with loan-loss provisioning coverage as the check
Bank.never: an FCFF DCF: capex, working capital and debt have no operating meaning for a bank
Bank.floor_basis_default: book value per share, read with provisioning coverage; the residual-income model verifies it

Insurer.lens: operating-profit multiple read with the solvency ratio
Insurer.never: an FCFF DCF or headline EPS: reserves and float distort both
Insurer.floor_basis_default: AOCI-adjusted book value per share; reserve adequacy not assessed; the insurer model verifies it from filed statements

RegulatedUtility.lens: rate-base growth and authorised ROE against the company's own operating EPS guidance; never revenue, since fuel passes through
RegulatedUtility.never: an FCFF DCF mid capex cycle: rate-base construction reads as value destruction
RegulatedUtility.floor_basis_default: the regulated rate base at the authorised ROE

MerchantPower.lens: EV/EBITDA and pre-growth FCF against the multi-year earnings build, by regional clearing price
MerchantPower.never: a single-year FCF or a P/E: earnings are policy- and price-dependent
MerchantPower.floor_basis_default: contracted capacity revenue at the regional clearing price

Reit.lens: price/AFFO and dividend coverage by AFFO; never accounting EPS
Reit.never: accounting EPS or an FCFF DCF: depreciation dominates both
Reit.floor_basis_default: AFFO per share and the dividend it covers

Miner.lens: NAV and reserve life; never spot FCF
Miner.never: spot FCF or an FCFF DCF: commodity price and reserve depletion dominate
Miner.floor_basis_default: NAV of proven and probable reserves at a long-run price deck

Royalty.lens: NAV of the royalty book; AISC is inverted for this class, rising costs are a tailwind
Royalty.never: an AISC screen (sign inversion) or an operator's cost lens
Royalty.floor_basis_default: NAV of the royalty book at a long-run price deck

HighGrowthSoftware.lens: recurring revenue growth, retention and the margin path; never P/E or FCF yield
HighGrowthSoftware.never: P/E, FCF yield, or a DCF whose growth reverts inside the explicit horizon
HighGrowthSoftware.floor_basis_default: none from this tool: the value is the growth path, which a floor cannot carry

PreProfit.lens: cash runway against the catalyst calendar; no multiple applies
PreProfit.floor_basis_default: no floor: nothing under the price until the catalyst; runway is a clock, not a floor

Wrapper.lens: NAV premium or discount plus the distribution decomposed by source; never headline yield
Wrapper.never: headline yield or a DCF: the wrapper holds other securities
Wrapper.floor_basis_default: NAV per unit of the holdings

ConstructionStage.lens: percent complete, distance to first production, debt paydown against the deadline
ConstructionStage.never: any earnings or cash-flow multiple before first production
ConstructionStage.floor_basis_default: none until first production; the build is the exposure

UnderBid.lens: the announced offer price; all other valuation suspended
UnderBid.never: any model other than the offer terms
UnderBid.floor_basis_default: the announced offer price, subject to completion

Ballast.lens: nothing; held as a hedge, no directional thesis
Ballast.floor_basis_default: no floor by construction: held as a hedge without a directional thesis
